name: deep-review
description: Multi-dimensional PR review orchestrator. Dispatches parallel reviewers (spec-conformance, correctness, test-quality, docs-sync, robustness, security, ux, performance, structure, code-quality, skill-plugin-quality) and synthesizes findings into an actionable punch list. Supports project-level custom reviewers via `docs/rules/review/` and ships a `reviewer-creator` skill for scaffolding them.

interface.longDescription: Runs a formal, multi-dimensional review of a pull request by dispatching parallel reviewers (spec-conformance, correctness, test-quality, docs-sync, plus tag-conditional robustness / security / UX / performance / structure / code-quality / skill-plugin-quality) and synthesizing findings into a Blocking / Non-blocking / Architectural punch list. Each reviewer's checklist, Detection table, worked scenarios, and output contract live in `references/reviewers/<name>.md` and are passed verbatim into the subagent prompt to prevent context drift. Supports project-level custom reviewers via `docs/rules/review/` and ships a `reviewer-creator` skill for scaffolding them. Designed for the auriga workflow in https://github.com/Ben2pc/auriga-cli.
